description:
Pure derivation surfaces exposed by the acs.py entry point: slug and the docs fan-out batching. Each is a pure function of its arguments, so a golden value here is a decision table the release must not move silently.

This group also held the lane grid — `lane derive`, `lane rank`, `stakes recommend` and the axis guard, 28 cases pinning the size x stakes decision table. ADR-0095 retired the grid: rigor is one judgement made from `plan.md` by /acs:ship, recorded as a delivery path, and there is no pure function left to tabulate. Its successor surface, `acs path show|set`, needs a ticket partition and so lives in the ticketed-profile group `13-delivery-path.json` rather than here.
